blocks.text: The 2026 CinePanalo Film Festival opens Wednesday, Sept. 23, with student short films that tackle difficult subjects such as abuse, unwanted pregnancy, violence and extrajudicial killings. This year’s edition marks a shift from the festival’s previous focus on inspiring stories. Organizers removed genre, topic and theme restrictions for 2026, allowing filmmakers to explore stories rooted in horror, suspense, crime and darker social realities. Among the student entries is “Limlim,” directed by Samantha Beatriz Acoja Palaje.
